        if red[y,x]: c='R'
        elif bright[y,x]: c='.'
        elif glassish[y,x]: c='G'
        elif dark[y,x]: c='#'
        else:
            brown = (r[y,x]>g[y,x]) and (g[y,x]>=b[y,x])
            c='b' if brown else 'o'
        line+=c
    print(line)
